functionalRequirement: User shall be able to share files, screen share, conduct group screen sharing, and send contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: File and screen sharing operations must complete within 5 seconds for files up to 100 MB, with less than 500ms latency for screen sharing updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures smooth and responsive file and screen sharing experiences across different file sizes and sharing scenarios.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must support resumable file transfers and automatically retry screen sharing connections up to 3 times in case of network interruptions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides resilience for file sharing and screen sharing features to handle potential network instabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All shared files and screen sharing sessions must be encrypted end-to-end using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive information during file and contact sharing to prevent unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages for failed file transfers, with specific guidance on potential resolution steps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users understand and potentially resolve issues during file and contact sharing processes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The file sharing and screen sharing features must be compatible with at least 3 major operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and support common file formats across platforms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures broad accessibility and consistent functionality across different user environments.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authentication: Implement multi-factor authentication with at least two verification methods (e.g., password + SMS code or biometric).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances account security during the sign-up and credential validation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide real-time password strength feedback during account creation, requiring a minimum of 12 characters with mixed character types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users to create strong, secure credentials while improving the sign-up experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain a 99.9% uptime for the authentication and credential validation system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can consistently access the Snap camera screen without prolonged login interruptions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete credential validation and Snap camera screen access within 2 seconds of successful authentication.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a quick and responsive login experience for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Store user credentials using salted bcrypt hashing with a minimum work factor of 12.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user credentials from potential security breaches through advanced password storage techniques.
